name: Vikings
description: From the first raids on Northumbria to the last great invasion of England.

mission.history: Strange ships have been seen off the coast of Northumbria. The monks of Lindisfarne have gold and silver on their altars and no swords.
mission.briefing: Raid the holy island at Bamburgh and the monastery at Durham.
mission.victory_text: The church of St Cuthbert is plundered. The Viking Age has begun.
mission.defeat_text: The Northumbrians burn your camp, and the ships sail home empty.

mission.history: The sons of Ragnar Lothbrok have landed in East Anglia with the greatest army England has ever seen, sworn to avenge their father.
mission.briefing: Take York from the quarrelling Northumbrians, then Nottingham in Mercia.
mission.victory_text: York is yours, and half of England will be the Danelaw.
mission.defeat_text: East Anglia rises behind you, and the great army breaks up.

events.text: King Charles the Bald gathers an army at Saint-Denis.

mission.history: A hundred and twenty longships under a chief called Ragnar have rowed up the Seine. Rouen is taken, and the road to Paris lies open.
mission.briefing: Row up the Seine and sack Paris on Easter Sunday.
mission.victory_text: Paris is sacked, and Charles the Bald pays seven thousand pounds of silver to see you go.
mission.defeat_text: The Franks retake Rouen, and the fleet is trapped in the river.

mission.history: Harald, king in Vestfold, asked for the hand of Gyda, who said she would not marry a man who ruled less than all of Norway. Harald has sworn not to cut his hair until he does.
mission.briefing: Beat the petty kings of the west at Hafrsfjord and unite Norway.
mission.victory_text: The kings of the west fall at Hafrsfjord. Harald cuts his hair, and Norway is one kingdom.
mission.defeat_text: Tønsberg falls, and Harald's hair grows on.

mission.history: Rollo and his Danes have raided the Seine for years. King Charles the Simple, tired of war, may give them the land if they can keep it.
mission.briefing: Hold Rouen until the king comes to terms.
mission.victory_text: At Saint-Clair-sur-Epte Charles grants Rollo the land around Rouen. It will be called Normandy.
mission.defeat_text: The Franks take Rouen, and Rollo's Danes are scattered.

events.text: Sweyn and Olof of Sweden join their fleets against Olaf.

mission.history: Olaf Tryggvason has made Norway Christian with fire and sword. Now the kings of Denmark and Sweden and the jarl Eric lie in wait for him off the island of Svolder.
mission.briefing: Destroy the Danish fleet before the allies close the trap.
mission.victory_text: The Long Serpent wins the day, and Olaf's enemies flee.
mission.defeat_text: Trondheim falls, and Olaf leaps from the Long Serpent into the sea.

mission.history: Sweyn Forkbeard, king of Denmark, has come for the English crown. His fleet holds the Channel, and Æthelred the Unready is losing his kingdom town by town.
mission.briefing: Take London and York, and Sweyn will be king of England.
mission.victory_text: London submits, Æthelred flees to Normandy, and Sweyn is king of England.
mission.defeat_text: Winchester falls, and the Danes go home.

mission.history: Cnut rules England and Denmark. King Olaf of Norway and King Anund Jacob of Sweden have joined against him and raid Scania while he is away.
mission.briefing: Beat the allies and make yourself king of Norway, Denmark and the Swedes.
mission.victory_text: Olaf flees to Russia. Cnut is king of England, Denmark, Norway and part of Sweden.
mission.defeat_text: Zealand falls, and Cnut's North Sea empire is broken.

events.text: Tostig's ships join the fleet in the Humber.

mission.history: King Edward is dead, and Harald Hardrada, the last great Viking, claims his throne. Three hundred ships have come up the Humber.
mission.briefing: Take York and then London, and become king of England.
mission.victory_text: Harold Godwinson falls, and a Norwegian sits on the English throne.
mission.defeat_text: At Stamford Bridge the English catch you without your mail, and the Viking Age ends with you.
